subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Care a hang

options.text: Putting an outfit on a hanger

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"care a hang"** means to show **no interest or to not care at all.** (कोई दिलचस्पी नहीं दिखाना या बिल्कुल भी परवाह नहीं करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He doesn't **care a hang** about what people think of him.
 
 
 
• **"Showing no interest"** means to be indifferent or not concerned about something. (बिना किसी दिलचस्पी के होना या किसी चीज की परवाह न करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite all the excitement, she** showed no interest **in the event.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hanging clothes to dry** (कपड़े सुखाने के लिए लटकाना): The act of suspending clothes on a line or rack to dry.

 
 
• **Example:** She was hanging clothes to dry in the backyard.
 
 
 
• **Putting an outfit on a hanger** (कपड़ों को हैंगर पर लगाना): The act of placing clothes on a hanger for storage.
 
 
• **Example: **He carefully put his suit on a hanger to keep it wrinkle-free.
 
 
 
• **Caring too much** (बहुत ज्यादा परवाह करना): Being excessively concerned about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She is always caring too much about her grades.
